messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with you and to prove ourselves as a great long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to present our offer for a price of €47.00 per unit, along with a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain flexible and look forward to hearing from you soon so we can start building a strong partnership together.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

messages.subject: Bearing bracket HN: quality commitment and revised pricing
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

The scorecard sc:70140@2026Q3 records 2376 ppm, supporting the need for a binding quality improvement plan.

The delivery performance in sc:70140@2026Q3 is 63.5%, requiring corrective action alongside the quality commitment.

Please quote €44.00 per piece with a 300 ppm commitment and €500 recovery per complaint, retaining the fixed enquiry terms. Could you explain the cost drivers behind your pricing and how you would achieve this quality level? Please also provide a dated corrective-action plan covering process controls and delivery reliability.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: Bearing bracket HN: quality commitment and revised pricing
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. As to the quality record data you cited, we see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Hello, we checked the scorecard sc:70140@2026Q3 and our guys will get back to you on the delivery and quality plans. Material accounts for about 30 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Jumping straight to 300 ppm and a 500 EUR penalty is too much risk for us, so I put in 1500 ppm and 150 EUR instead. I can keep the price at 47.00 EUR with these better terms, but we really need to talk about faster payment. Our current Angebot is a price of €49.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €500.00 per complaint. Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 1500 ppm and a chargeback of €150.00 per complaint: €47.00 per unit. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Quality: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

Freight Forwarder: Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. With overtime we can deliver in 56 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Bearing brackets: revised commercial package
messages.body:

Could you reduce the price to €46.00 while retaining the 300 ppm commitment and €500 complaint recovery? Please distinguish the recurring inspection cost from the one-off process-improvement cost: this would help identify a lower-cost route without weakening quality protection.

Please also quote your lowest price for 800 ppm with €500 complaint recovery as a separate alternative. All other enquiry terms remain unchanged.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing
